source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 8ης Μαΐου — «Άγιος Ελλάδιος Επίσκοπος Ωξέρρης»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 8 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. **He is none of the three Helladii the corpus keeps**: `helladius-27-may` is a hieromartyr, `helladius-the-commentaresios` a martyr under Maximian and `helladius-the-layman` a companion of Theophilus of Libya; this one is a bishop of Auxerre in Gaul who died in peace, and the name sweep raised the other three on the name alone. **`locations` are left out**: the see is recorded in `office` in the corpus's English, and the page gives no other place at all. The whole page is that one sentence plus the head line's «(; - 387)» — no country named beyond the city, no consecration, no relics, no hymn.
